title: Kick off the Holidays with Offers from Noodles & Company

# Kick off the Holidays with Offers from Noodles & Company


The holidays are right around the corner, bringing busy schedules, endless to-do lists, and less time to plan meals. That's where Noodles & Company comes in! Whether you're looking for a quick lunch between holiday errands or a comforting dinner after a long day, Noodles makes it easy to enjoy a delicious, satisfying meal. With a variety of flavorful pasta bowls, including our new[Ramen category](https://www.noodles.com/menu/ramen) , there's something to satisfy every craving.


To make the season even better,[Noodles Rewards](https://noodles.com/rewards) Members can enjoy exclusive offers and perks! Not a member yet? Signing up is easy. Simply download the Noodles & Company app or visit our website to get started.


Plus, new Noodles Rewards Members can earn a **FREE Regular Entrée** after making their first purchase of $10 or more (before taxes and fees) within 30 days of joining. It's just one more reason to treat yourself this holiday season!


Want to learn more? Check out the[Noodles Rewards](https://www.noodles.com/blog/rewards) blog to discover all the benefits of being a member.


## Save on Holiday Catering with Noodles & Company


This holiday season we also have a[catering](https://www.noodles.com/catering) code that is available for all guests to use. From 11/1 to 12/31, we are offering **15% off catering orders of $150+** with coupon code **JOY2026** . From Friendsgiving Dinner to Family Holiday Gatherings or Office Holiday Celebrations, Noodles Catering is the perfect option for any holiday party you are hosting this season! With options like our[Baked Chicken Parmesan](https://www.noodles.com/menu/chef-curated-with-protein/baked-chicken-parmesan) ,[Creamy Cheddar Mac & Cheese](https://www.noodles.com/menu/mac-cheese/creamy-cheddar-mac-cheese) , and the[Crispy Chicken Bacon Alfredo](https://www.noodles.com/menu/chef-curated-with-protein/crispy-chicken-bacon-alfredo) , you can curate a spread that everyone will enjoy. Each of our catering pans feeds around eight people, and we are also able to provide hot hold kits that will keep menu items warm and delectable all evening long.


To make it even easier, Noodles & Company has customizable[catering packages](https://www.noodles.com/catering) that include a salad, cheesy garlic bread and your choice between a dessert tray or beverages. This is all rounded out by the pasta pans you want to add, which includes vegetarian-friendly and gluten-free options for guests that have dietary preferences or restrictions, as well as a multitude of kid-friendly options that are great for everyone. Choose from the Feed the Few, which serves up to 10 people, or the Feed the Many that satisfies up to 20 people.


Want to keep it simple? Order the[Mac Bar](https://www.noodles.com/catering/mac-bar) which comes complete with our famous Creamy Cheddar Mac & Cheese as well as a variety of toppings and sauces so that you and your guests can create your own masterpiece. All these options are available to order from our catering menu. Use the coupon code **JOY2026** throughout November and December and let us take something off your plate this holiday season.


## Noodles & Company's Holiday Gift Card Promotion


Here at Noodles & Company, we love to spread joy and cheer during every season, but especially during the holidays. In that spirit, we are ecstatic to offer a special[Noodles Gift Card](https://www.noodles.com/gift-cards) promotion that is available to everyone! With any purchase of **$50 or more** in Noodles & Company gift cards, buyers will receive an additional **$10 bonus card** which can be redeemed from 11/4/2026 – 1/13/2027.


This is the perfect opportunity to stock up and save for any large orders you are planning to place in the future or can be just a fun little bonus to keep for a day where you don't feel like cooking. Have a White Elephant exchange or someone on your list that is particularly hard to buy for? Give the gift of Noodles, everyone loves a bowl of warm comfort, and it comes at an unbeatable price.


We wish everyone a fun and safe holiday season! If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to us at[contactnoodles.smg.com](https://contactnoodles.smg.com/) . We are always here to help no matter what, and we want to make sure your experience is always excellent. Happy Holidays!
